title: Chronic Pain in Spinal Cord Injury
brief_summary: This trial tests the effectiveness of the drug amitriptyline vs placebo to relieve chronic pain in adults that have had a spinal cord injury.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Spinal Cord Injury six months ago or longer
* Pain for 3 months or longer

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of cardiovascular disease, seizures, or glaucoma
* Currently taking antidepressant medications
* Currently hyperthyroid or taking thyroid medicine
* Currently pregnant
